articles.title_en: Law-Abiding Immigrants: The Incarceration Gap between Immigrants and the US-Born, 1870–2020
articles.title_cn: 守法移民：移民与美国本土出生者之间的监禁差距，1870-2020
articles.abstract_en: We provide the first nationally representative long-run series (1870–2020) of incarceration rates for immigrants and the US-born. As a group, immigrants have had lower incarceration rates than the US-born for 150 years. Moreover, relative to the US-born, immigrants’ incarceration rates have declined since 1960: immigrants today are 60 percent less likely to be incarcerated (30 percent relative to US-born Whites). This relative decline occurred among immigrants from all regions and cannot be explained by changes in observable characteristics or immigration policy. Instead, the decline is part of a broader divergence of outcomes between less-educated immigrants and their US-born counterparts. (JEL J15, K37, K42, N31, N32, N41, N42)
articles.abstract_cn: 我们提供了首个具有全国代表性的移民和美国本土出生者监禁率的长期序列（1870-2020年）。作为一个群体，移民的监禁率在150年间一直低于美国本土出生者。此外，相对于美国本土出生者，自1960年以来移民的监禁率有所下降：如今移民被监禁的可能性降低了60%（相对于美国本土出生的白人降低了30%）。这种相对下降发生在来自所有地区的移民中，并且无法用可观察特征或移民政策的变化来解释。相反，这种下降是受教育程度较低的移民与其美国本土出生同龄人之间结果更广泛分化的一部分。（JEL J15, K37, K42, N31, N32, N41, N42）

articles.title_en: On the Equilibrium Properties of Spatial Models
articles.abstract_en: We consider a broad class of spatial models where there are many types of interactions across a large number of locations. We provide a new theorem that offers an iterative algorithm for calculating an equilibrium and sufficient and “globally necessary” conditions under which the equilibrium is unique. We show how this theorem enables the characterization of equilibrium properties for one important spatial system: an urban model with spillovers across a large number of different types of agents. An online appendix provides 12 additional examples of both spatial and nonspatial economic frameworks for which our theorem provides new equilibrium characterizations. (JEL C21, R15, R23)
articles.abstract_cn: 我们考虑一类广泛的空间模型，其中在大量地点之间存在多种类型的相互作用。我们提供了一个新定理，该定理给出了一种用于计算均衡的迭代算法，以及均衡唯一性的充分条件和“全局必要”条件。我们展示了该定理如何能够刻画一个重要空间系统的均衡性质：一个在大量不同类型代理人之间存在溢出效应的城市模型。在线附录提供了12个额外的空间和非空间经济框架示例，我们的定理为这些框架提供了新的均衡刻画。（JEL C21, R15, R23）

articles.title_en: The Impact of Criminal Financial Sanctions: A Multistate Analysis of Survey and Administrative Data
articles.title_cn: 刑事金融制裁的影响：基于调查与行政数据的多州分析
articles.abstract_en: We estimate the impact of financial sanctions in the US criminal justice system, leveraging nine natural experiments in a regression discontinuity design framework across a diverse range of enforcement levels ($17–$6,000) and institutional environments. We leverage survey and administrative data to consider a variety of short- and long-term outcomes, including employment, recidivism, household expenditures, and other self-reported measures of well-being. We find robust evidence of precise null effects, including ruling out long-run impacts larger than −$391–$142 in annual earnings and −0.001–0.01 in annual convictions, with no corresponding payment increases despite salient and heterogeneous enforcement mechanisms. (JEL G51, H76, J31, K14, K41, K42)
articles.abstract_cn: 我们估算了美国刑事司法系统中金融制裁的影响，利用回归不连续设计框架中的九个自然实验，涵盖了不同的执法水平（$17–$6,000）和制度环境。我们利用调查和行政数据来考察各种短期和长期结果，包括就业、再犯、家庭支出以及其他自我报告的福祉指标。我们发现了精确零效应的稳健证据，包括排除了年收入低于−$391–$142和年定罪次数低于−0.001-0.01的长期影响，尽管存在显著且异质的执法机制，但相应的支付并未增加。（JEL G51, H76, J31, K14, K41, K42）

articles.title_en: Noise-Tolerant Community Enforcement and the Strength of Small Stakes
articles.title_cn: 容忍噪声的社区执行与小赌注的强度
articles.abstract_en: We study community enforcement in a large population with noisy monitoring. We focus on equilibria in the prisoner’s dilemma that are coordination proof, meaning that matched partners never play a Pareto-dominated Nash equilibrium in the one-shot game induced by the equilibrium continuation payoffs at their current histories. We show that a noise-tolerant version of contagion strategies is optimal among all coordination-proof equilibria. Welfare under tolerant contagion strategies decreases in the noise level and the gain from defection faster than welfare in a fixed partnership does. Thus, community enforcement has a comparative advantage in supporting “ low-stakes”relationships. (JEL C72, C73, C78, Z13)
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究了在具有噪声监测的大群体中的社区执行。我们关注囚徒困境中协调证明的均衡，这意味着匹配的伙伴在当前历史的均衡延续收益所诱导的一次性博弈中，永远不会玩帕累托支配的纳什均衡。我们表明，在所有协调证明的均衡中，容忍噪声的传染策略版本是最优的。在容忍传染策略下的福利随着噪声水平和背叛收益的增加而下降，其速度比固定伙伴关系中的福利下降更快。因此，社区执行在支持“低赌注”关系方面具有比较优势。（JEL C72, C73, C78, Z13）

articles.title_en: Is There Too Little Antitrust Enforcement in the US Hospital Sector?
articles.title_cn: 美国医院部门的反垄断执法是否过少？
articles.abstract_en: From 2002 to 2020, there were over 1,000 mergers of US hospitals. During this period, the FTC took enforcement actions against 13 transactions. However, using the FTC’s standard screening tools, we find that 20 percent of these mergers could have been predicted to meaningfully lessen competition. We show that, from 2010 to 2015, predictably anticompetitive mergers resulted in price increases over 5 percent. We estimate that approximately half of predictably anticompetitive mergers had to be reported to the FTC per the Hart–Scott–Rodino Act. We conclude that there appears to be underenforcement of antitrust laws in the hospital sector. (JEL G34, G38, I11, K21)
articles.abstract_cn: 从2002年到2020年，美国医院发生了超过1,000起合并。在此期间，联邦贸易委员会对13起交易采取了执法行动。然而，使用联邦贸易委员会的标准筛选工具，我们发现这些合并中有20%本可被预测会显著削弱竞争。我们表明，从2010年到2015年，可预测的反竞争合并导致价格涨幅超过5%。我们估计，根据《哈特-斯科特-罗迪诺法案》，大约一半可预测的反竞争合并必须向联邦贸易委员会报告。我们得出结论，医院部门的反垄断执法似乎存在不足。（JEL G34, G38, I11, K21）

articles.title_en: Coordination with Differential Time Preferences: Experimental Evidence
articles.title_cn: 具有不同时间偏好的协调：实验证据
articles.abstract_en: The experimental literature on repeated games has largely focused on settings where players discount the future identically. In applications, however, interactions often occur between players whose time preferences differ. We study experimentally the effects of discounting differentials in infinitely repeated coordination games. In our data, differential discount factors play two roles. First, they provide a coordination anchor: more impatient players get higher payoffs first. Introducing even small discounting differentials reduces coordination failures significantly. Second, with pronounced discounting differentials, intertemporal trades are prevalent: impatient players get higher payoffs for an initial phase and patient players get higher payoffs in perpetuity afterward. (JEL C72, C92, D15, D25)
articles.abstract_cn: 关于重复博弈的实验文献主要关注参与者对未来贴现相同的设定。然而，在应用中，互动往往发生在时间偏好不同的参与者之间。我们通过实验研究了无限重复协调博弈中贴现差异的影响。在我们的数据中，贴现因子的差异扮演两个角色。首先，它们提供了一个协调锚点：更不耐烦的参与者首先获得更高的收益。即使引入微小的贴现差异也能显著减少协调失败。其次，在显著的贴现差异下，跨期交易普遍存在：不耐烦的参与者在初始阶段获得更高的收益，而耐心的参与者此后永久获得更高的收益。(JEL C72, C92, D15, D25)

articles.abstract_en: We document a sizeable increase in the frequency of price adjustments following the large energy shocks of 2022. We use a tractable New Keynesian model, calibrated to the preshock data, to interpret such a pattern. The calibration highlights the state dependence of firms’ decisions: prices are adjusted rapidly when markups are misaligned. In the model, a large cost shock triggers a swift increase in the frequency of price adjustments, causing a rapid pass-through from costs to prices. Time-dependent models, such as the Calvo model, miss this frequency response, failing to capture the sudden inflation surge after a large shock. (JEL D22, E12, E31, L11, L66, Q43)
articles.abstract_cn: 我们记录了在2022年大型能源冲击后价格调整频率的显著增加。我们使用一个易于处理的、根据冲击前数据校准的新凯恩斯模型来解释这种模式。校准强调了企业决策的状态依赖性：当加成失调时，价格会迅速调整。在该模型中，大规模成本冲击会触发价格调整频率的迅速增加，导致成本向价格的快速传导。时间依赖模型，如卡尔沃模型，无法捕捉这种频率响应，从而未能捕捉到大冲击后突然的通胀飙升。（JEL D22, E12, E31, L11, L66, Q43）

articles.title_en: The AI Dilemma: Growth versus Existential Risk
articles.title_cn: 人工智能困境：增长与生存风险
articles.abstract_en: Advances in artificial intelligence (AI) are a double-edged sword. On the one hand, they may increase economic growth as AI augments our ability to innovate. On the other hand, many experts worry that these advances entail existential risk: creating a superintelligence misaligned with human values could lead to catastrophic outcomes, even possibly human extinction. This paper considers the optimal use of AI technology in the presence of these opportunities and risks. Under what conditions should we continue the rapid progress of AI, and under what conditions should we stop? (JEL D11, D81, H43, I31, O31)
articles.abstract_cn: 人工智能（AI）的进步是一把双刃剑。一方面，随着AI增强我们创新的能力，它们可能促进经济增长。另一方面，许多专家担心这些进步会带来生存风险：创造与人类价值观不一致的超级智能可能导致灾难性后果，甚至可能使人类灭绝。本文考虑了在这些机遇和风险存在的情况下AI技术的最优使用。在什么条件下我们应该继续AI的快速发展，在什么条件下我们应该停止？（JEL D11, D81, H43, I31, O31）
